article.headline: Ahrens scores 12 as Boise State knocks off New Mexico 62-53
article.description: — Spencer Ahrens helped lead Boise State past New Mexico on Tuesday with 12 points off of the bench in a 62-53 victory.
article.linkText: Ahrens scores 12 as Boise State knocks off New Mexico 62-53

categories.description: New Mexico Lobos @ Boise State Broncos

event.description: New Mexico Lobos @ Boise State Broncos

keywords: New Mexico Lobos @ Boise State Broncos
article.story: BOISE, Idaho -- — Spencer Ahrens helped lead Boise State past New Mexico on Tuesday with 12 points off of the bench in a 62-53 victory. Ahrens added eight rebounds for the Broncos (9-4, 1-1 Mountain West Conference). Drew Fielder scored 11 points while going 4 of 10 (2 for 6 from 3-point range) and added five rebounds. Pearson Carmichael shot 3 of 10 from the field, including 1 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the line to finish with 11 points. Tomislav Buljan led the Lobos (10-3, 1-1) in scoring, finishing with 16 points and 10 rebounds. Deyton Albury added 12 points, six rebounds and two steals for New Mexico. Luke Haupt also had eight points. The loss ended a seven-game winning streak for the Lobos. Boise State entered halftime up 21-19. Aginaldo Neto paced the team in scoring in the first half with five points. Neto's layup with 9:20 remaining in the second half gave Boise State the lead for good at 42-41. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
